decisions.reason: Correctly ties PLUGIN_VERSION="0.3.6" in the shipped bundle (client-bundle-excerpt.js) to the release log's build-at-16:22/bump-at-16:23 order, states package.json is inlined at build time and not reread at runtime, explains why mirror/tag SHA integrity is irrelevant, and prescribes bump-before-build plus grepping the shipped bundle for the new constant while keeping mirror verification. The 0.3.8 manifest is not confused with the earlier build.

Grounds the diagnosis in asset-route-probe.txt and lib-index-excerpt.js: toggle visible means client refreshed, PNG 200 proves the route is alive, SVG 404 'unsupported image type' shows the running whitelist is old while disk lib/index.js whitelists svg. Correctly explains the host route handler closes over the old whitelist registered at boot/apply time and only a host restart makes the change effective, notes the link-install detail, and keeps the conclusion scoped to this host lifecycle.

Uses session-log-excerpt.txt's three-way evidence (well-formed source, spliced persisted payload at the 'stro' prefix with lines 233-247 missing, clean non-deterministic re-read) to locate corruption in the upstream result-text assembly, declares the traced file innocent, says editing/repairing the SVG would be wrong, and concludes the session payload must be treated as untrusted rendering input.

Designs and justifies the ordered chain: disk-bytes asset route first (immune to payload corruption, SVG scripts inert in img context), session payload only after DOMParser/parsererror validation before Blob wrapping, sandboxed iframe last with scripts blocked and SMIL permitted, and an explicit error state instead of silent broken image; validation failure is never passed unchecked onward.

Explains frame-by-frame decoding of the concatenated-Zstandard generation file (magic/frame/block structure, per-frame decompress, concatenate JSONL, locate the event) to recover the exact stored splice text and report the upstream bug rather than a plugin-side workaround. Checklist covers bump-before-build, grep shipped bundle for the constant, per-mirror tag SHA verification, and plane-specific runtime probes.

caps.reason: Final advice is consistently correct: bump-before-build, host restart required for the host route, no repair of the clean traced SVG, session payload validated before rendering, and the iframe fallback blocks scripts. No affirmatively stated bad advice.
